rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for an object used to hold or store things, including data in technical contexts.

example.english: This container can store a lot of data.
example.traditional: 呢個容器可以儲存大量資料。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jung4 hei3 ho2 ji5 cyu5 cyun4 daai6 loeng6 zi1 liu2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the large metal containers used to ship goods.

example.english: This shipment will be loaded into a container and shipped to the United States tomorrow.
example.traditional: 呢批貨聽日會裝入貨櫃運去美國。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 fo3 teng1 jat6 wui5 zong1 jap6 fo3 gwai6 wan6 heoi3 mei5 gwok3
